title: Miley, Elton John & More Artists With Billboard 200-Topping Album Titles That Included Names of Musical Instruments
summary: Miley’s album is the first with the word “bass” in its title to top the chart, though Meghan Trainor deserves a mention.
contentText:
By entering the Billboard 200 at No. 1 on the list dated Oct. 3, Miley ’s Bass Persuades joins a short list of No. 1 albums that include the names of musical instruments in their titles.

Miley’s album is the first with the word “bass” in its title to top the chart. Meghan Trainor ’s debut album, which contained her breakthrough smash “All About That Bass,” was titled Title. “All About That Bass” topped the Billboard Hot 100 for eight consecutive weeks in 2014 and went on to receive Grammy nods for record and song of the year.

Improbably, another album on this list has a variation of the word “Persuades” in its title. That’s Terry Snyder and the All-Stars’ Persuasive Percussion, which topped the Billboard 200 for 13 weeks in 1960.

This list also includes a classical album that became a phenomenon, an album that served as the soundtrack to an Oscar-nominated film and albums by two of the best-selling album acts in history: Herb Alpert & the Tijuana Brass and Elton John .

Related

Miley Earns First Billboard 200 No. 1 in More Than a Decade With ‘Bass Persuades’

As Billboard reported on Sept. 28, Bass Persuades is Miley’s first No. 1 album on the Billboard 200 in more than a decade, since Bangerz in 2013. That album, which spawned the hits “We Can’t Stop” and “Wrecking Ball,” the latter her first Hot 100 No. 1, firmly positioned Cyrus as a contemporary pop star and brought her her first Grammy nomination, for best pop vocal album.

Here’s a full list of albums that topped the Billboard 200 whose titles include names of musical instruments. They are listed in chronological order.
